# homepage

> A static blog and personal home page written in Markdown, deployed to GitHub Pages

This repository builds a personal home page and a Blog from Markdown and JSON settings into static HTML. It is the source of [woonyong.com](https://woonyong.com). The internal document renderer in `src/document` parses Markdown, and the internal design system in `src/design` owns tokens, CSS, and shared components.
